meta.title: Your Bank Deposit Insurance Has A Limit Most People Don't Know
meta.hook: If your bank fails, the government doesn't cover everything in your account. It covers up to a specific number.
meta.description: FDIC deposit insurance protects up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category, not an unlimited amount and not the whole bank. A single account over that limit isn't automatically fully covered; married couples and different account types can each extend coverage further. It's one of the more misunderstood safety nets in American banking. Educational content only, not financial advice.
